2473: Satoshi (known as Ash Ketchum in most international territories) is the main character of the Pocket Monsters anime.
3891: Pikachu is the signature Pokémon of the Pocket Monsters anime, and the first Pokémon that Satoshi obtained on his journey as a Pokémon Trainer, given to him by Professor Okido.
3935: Musashi is a member of the Rocket Gang, more specifically part of a trio with Kojirou and Nyarth, that follows Satoshi and his friends around in the Pocket Monsters anime, usually trying to steal Satoshi's Pikachu.
3936: Kojirou is a member of the Rocket Gang, more specifically part of a trio with Musashi and Nyarth, that follows Satoshi and his friends around in the Pocket Monsters anime, usually trying to steal Satoshi's Pikachu.
3937: Nyarth is a member of Rocket-dan (Team Rocket), more specifically part of a trio with Musashi and Kojirou, that follows Satoshi and his friends around in the Pokémon anime, usually trying to steal Satoshi's Pikachu.
7558: Nurse Joy is a recurring character in every Pokemon series released. There are multiple Nurse Joys in every town, city and region. They all look the same, have the same voice and personalities.
9881: Sakaki is the Rocket Team Boss and a former Tokiwa City Gym Leader. He is a very ambitious man and is intolerant of failure. Sakaki is shown to have access to vast wealth and resources.
17783: Yukinari Ookido is a Pokémon Professor and a major supporting character of the Pocket Monsters anime who lives and works at his research lab in Masara Town. He appears semi-regularly to give Satoshi advice to help him achieve his goal of becoming the greatest Pokémon Master.
26545: Officer Jenny is not a single entity. Rather, there are many Jennys working as police officers across the various regions of the Pokémon world. Generally, Officer Jennies are brave and determined, but mostly ineffective in their police duties.
36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
42627: Giovanni's secretary is a recurring character in the Pokémon anime, making her debut appearance in Memories are Made of Bliss!.
87632: Serena is one of Ash's traveling companions during his journey in the Kalos region. Her main goal is to be named Kalos Queen, the highest prestige achievable for Pokémon Performers. She is a very kind and polite girl.
87633: Clemont is a Gym Leader of the Kalos region. He likes science and building new devices. He is the older brother of Bonnie. He isn't interested in strength, he enjoys spending his time with his Pokémon.
87634: Eureka is the younger sister of Citron in the anime and one of Satoshi's traveling companions.
87635: Alexa appears in Pokémon X and Y, working for a company as a journalist from Lumiose City
87636: Viola is the Santalune City Gym Leader and a user of Bug-type Pokémon. She is also a professional Pokémon photographer and the younger sister of Alexa.
87637: Professor Augustine Sycamore is a Pokemon Professor from the Kalos region
138744: Father of Clemont and Bonnie. He is also the identity of Blaziken Mask (Japanese: バシャーモかめん Bursyamo Mask).
138745: Citroid is the current Gym Leader of the Lumiose Gym in the anime, having been built by Clemont to fill in for him when he was busy.
138748: Saki is the mother of Serena. She is an accomplished Rhyhorn racer from Vaniville Town. In the Pokémon Adventures manga, she is the mother of Y.
138749: Barry is a character of the day who appeared in XY08. He is a famous Pokémon groomer who grooms several Furfrou in his shop. He is well known for his work and acts as a teacher to Jessica on the art of grooming Pokémon.
138750: She is one of Professor Sycamore's assistants.
139392: Lisa is a character of the day who appeared in Ep 14. She was an old lady who lived in a large mansion on her own. She passed away prior to the events of the episode, and was only featured in a prominent portrait in her former home and in a flashback.
146293: Zakuro is the Gym Leader of Cyllage City's Gym, known officially as the Cyllage Gym. He specializes in Rock-type Pokémon.
146294: Takeda is a character of the day who appeared in XY23. He is a researcher working at the Ambrette Town Fossil Lab.
146295: Lindsay is a character of the day who appeared in XY24. She is an "Underwater Archaeologist" along with her husband Eddy.
146296: Louden is a character of the day who appeared in XY22. He is the director of the Ambrette Aquarium.
146598: Corni is the Gym Leader of Shalour City's Gym, known officially as the Shalour Gym. She specializes in Fighting-type Pokémon.
158860: Carnet is the Pokémon champion of the Kalos region, her main Pokemon is her Sirnight who can Mega-Evolve.
190457: Sana is a young woman studying to be a Furfrou stylist. She is childhood friends with X, Y, Tierno, and Trevor and has known all of them ever since she was a child.
202780: Mache is the Gym Leader of Kunoe City, specializing in Fairy-type pokémon.
202781: Gojika is the Gym Leader of Hyakkoku City's Gym, known officially as the Hyakkoku Gym. She specializes in Psychic-type Pokémon. She gives the Psychic Badge to Trainers who defeat her. Gojika is pure-hearted and deeply empathetic.
202782: Fukuji is a gardener who is the Gym Leader of Hiyoku Gym, Hiyoku City's Gym. He specializes in Grass-type Pokémon and gives the Plant Badge to Trainers who defeat him. Fukuji enjoys a steady paced life and he is often seen riding his faithful Gogoat.
212867: Alain is a Pokémon Trainer seeking to defeat all Mega-Evolved Pokémon using his Mega Charizard X. He initially appears as the main character of the Mega Evolution Specials side-series, working under the instruction of Lysandre to collect Mega Evolution energy.
251355: Malva is a Fire-type Trainer and member of the Kalos Elite Four. In addition, she was also a member of Team Flare prior to the organization's disbandment.
322914: A Dark-type Pokémon, said to bring bad luck and cause misfortune whenever it appears. However, its horn is actually acutely sensitive to warning signs of natural disasters, and it often attempts to warn humans of them. Using the Absolite, it can Mega-Evolve into Mega Absol.
362903: She's a friend and rival of Serena.
405027: Elle is a Pokemon Performer and the current reigning Kalos Queen.
